stages.beat_note: Layla has arrived at the mining village on Floor 4, but hasn't yet learned how to pass beyond the sealed fortress gate or descend to Floor 5.

stages.summary: Something down there is worth more than the men standing in front of it.
stages.beat_note: Layla learned that the military fortress gate is locked, but Commander Malik holds an ancient Teleportation Scroll in his safe. She needs to infiltrate the fortress and retrieve it.
stages.update_message: Tariq said it is kept behind a door that does not open for you.

stages.beat_note: Having acquired the knowledge of the Teleportation Sigil, Layla can now reach the teleport platform in the heart of the fortress and descend.
stages.update_message: The way down was never a door.

stages.beat_note: Layla has arrived at the Floor 5 courtyard.

stages.quest_title: What They Put in the Cages
stages.summary: Living people went into the cages meant for grain.
stages.beat_note: Arriving at the Frost Citadel, Layla finds garrison dissenters Commander Astrid and Einar locked in culling cages along with commoner offerings. Defeat the Sentry Captain to obtain the courtyard key and unlock their cages.
stages.update_message: All of it is locked, and the key is on someone who does not mean to hand it over.

stages.summary: Three houses are coming. All three will open eventually.
stages.beat_note: The siege clock is running. Each wave opens another estate while its house sends troops toward the courtyard. Defeating or awakening a house leader stops that house's lane, but the remaining waves still begin on schedule.
stages.update_message: Every gate that lifts is a door you have to close yourself.

stages.beat_note: Wave 1 begins immediately after the prisoners are freed. House Frost-Wolf opens and starts the northern assault lane.
narrative_lines: A deep horn sounds from the north. The Frost-Wolf gate lifts, and boots begin striking the frozen avenue in formation.

stages.beat_note: Wave 2 begins fifteen in-game minutes after Wave 1 whether or not Frost-Wolf has been neutralized. House Iron-Ram opens its lane.
narrative_lines: A second horn answers from the southeast. The Iron-Ram portcullis rises through a cloud of steam as heavy troops march out.

stages.beat_note: Wave 3 begins fifteen in-game minutes after Wave 2 whether or not either earlier house has been neutralized. House Frost-Leopard opens its lane.
narrative_lines: A third horn cuts across the courtyard. The Frost-Leopard doors unlock, and shadows move behind the frosted glass.

stages.beat_note: House Frost-Wolf dispatches ten northern squads of three soldiers at three-minute intervals.
House Iron-Ram dispatches ten southeast squads of three soldiers at three-minute intervals.
House Frost-Leopard dispatches ten southwest squads of three soldiers at three-minute intervals.
Layla hasn't yet heard the dark truth about the village council surrendering the orphan boy Zayd as a sacrifice to the garrison.

stages.summary: Rashid has not stopped crying, and nobody in the village will say why.
stages.beat_note: Elder Rashid and Yasmin revealed that the village council offered Zayd up as a sacrifice. Layla needs to find the boy and rescue him from his iron cage.
stages.update_message: Find out what the council handed over, and take it back.

stages.summary: Get him back down the stairs.
stages.beat_note: Zayd is rescued from his cage. Escort him back to the safety of the worker village.
stages.update_message: He cannot keep the pace. Do not make him run.

stages.summary: Something in the square has been standing out there a long time without being spoken to.
stages.beat_note: Zayd gave Layla his father's miner lantern. Its warm light can awaken the sleeping memories within the guardian golem Sakhra.
stages.update_message: He gave you his father's light. Somebody ought to be the one to use it.

stages.beat_note: Layla has not yet engaged the Goblin Shaman on Floor 1.

stages.summary: There is a way through this cave that does not involve blood.
stages.beat_note: Having navigated the labyrinth without striking down any goblins or golems, Layla challenges the Goblin Shaman.
stages.update_message: Nobody down here has drawn a weapon yet. Keep it that way until there is no other way.
